questions.text: Describe a time when you saved money for something.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you saved money for something. You should say: what you saved for; how long it took you; how you saved the money; and explain how you felt when you finally had enough money.

questions.text: Are you good at saving money now?
questions.say: Thank you. Are you good at saving money now?

questions.text: Why do some people find it hard to save money?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you saved money for something, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all saving money. Why do some people find it hard to save money?

questions.text: Should parents give their children pocket money? Why or why not?
